shortDescription: Psycasts² — Diablo 2-style psycast skill levels, auto synergies (toggleable off), optional fog-of-war tree, a resizable PoE constellation spec tree, seven ascension constellations, meditation→awakening→3-tier enlightenment (pilgrimage completion reforms a caravan home), an always-on psycast tab with a dormant-pawn awakening card, enemy psycaster tiers, an XML awakening trigger API, TieringOverrideDef + BalanceOverrideDef handoffs, JSON balance export/import, optional hardcore reset-lockout, full keyed localization, celebration FX, and a PerfCache layer keeping TPS/FPS impact near zero.
body:
(spec excerpt - flat level cap, ISEKAI compat, psylink gate + random-Awakened spawn)

## Testing preference (standing)
ALWAYS launch with companion Modern Psycasts UI (`astryl.ModernPsycastsUI`, a workspace mod at e33ef407d712 — the user's own). For FULL addon coverage also load every installed 1.6 VPE addon: dev.tobot.vpe.betterautocast, Aranmaho.Makai.Psycast, Waffle.FantasyPatches, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Hemosage, Danzen.VPE.BiotechIntegration, Aranmaho.RavenousEye.Wildhunter.Psycast, VPE.Horaxian.Sentinel, Aranmaho.RangerClass, mute.vpesensitivity, VPE.Aeromancer.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAeromancer, VPE.Anima.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAnima, VPE.Arknights.Sentinel, VPE.Blader.Sentinel, VPE.Bugmancer.Sentinel, VPE.Framework.Sentinel, VPE.Deadlife.Sentinel, VPE.Geomancer.Sentinel, VPE.Gravcaster.Sentinel, VPE.Hydromancer.Sentinel, VPE.Luminis.Sentinel, VPE.Mechanitor.Sentinel, VPE.Neurophage.Sentinel, VPE.Oripathy.Sentinel, VPE.PhaseShift.Sentinel, VPE.Umbra.Sentinel, VPE.Veincaster.Sentinel, VPE.Voidweaver.Sentinel, morton.VPEAddOnPsycastCardRetextures, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Puppeteer. EXCLUDED: VPE.Gauranlen.Sentinel (missing dep vanillaexpanded.ideo.dryads), VPE.BiotechIntegration.Adendum, gwibbo.morepsygenes + Sl4vP0weR.NoPsycasts (not 1.6), VPersonaWeaponsE. ALSO test the standalone path occasionally (companionMods=[] → VPE-native tab, no Modern UI). Palette pins (tools take "T: " prefix; category is NOT a path segment): "Actions\T: Force awakening (Tier I)", "Actions\T: Grant psycaster level (+1)", "Actions\T: Max all psycast skills (absolute cap)". Known-unrelated noise: VPE .dds Texture2D load errors (e.g. PathBG_Archon.dds from workshop 2842502659 — fires even without Modern UI). cs-assets.json drift warnings for UI/Specs/* are concatenation false positives; keep them. NOTE: isolated test sessions keep their OWN mod-settings config (test-savedata/Config/Mod_*.xml); the Bake button writes ManualBalance.json into the mod folder itself, which persists.

## QOL + bug pass (2026-07-25) — "Undiscovered", psyset clicks, path-less joiners, always-on tab
- **"Undiscovered" instead of "Locked"** (Patch_LockedNoColon.cs). While `lockPathsToEnlightenment` is on, an un-offered tree reads `PS_Undiscovered` ("Undiscovered") in BOTH UIs; with our progression OFF, VPE's genuine "Locked: reason" is preserved (only the dangling colon is dropped). VPE-native = the existing string.Concat retarget (LockedLabel). Modern UI = NEW reflection-wired transpiler on `ModernPsycastsDrawer.DrawTreeTile` that rewrites the `ldstr "VPE.Locked"` in place to `call LockedKey()` (opcode+operand swap keeps labels/blocks; pattern miss = Log.Warning, IL untouched). Deliberately NOT done by overriding VPE's own keyed translation (that would leak into every other VPE surface).
- **BUG FIX: psyset editing was eaten by click-to-invest** (Patch_PsysetScope.cs). Root cause: both psyset editors draw icons through `PsycastsUIUtility.DrawAbility` and register their OWN ButtonInvisible on the same rect AFTER our postfix; the first IMGUI button under the cursor consumes the click, so every psyset click became "invest a level" and only skills at the ABSOLUTE cap (where our button is not drawn) could be added. Fix = `PsysetScope` depth flag, Enter in a prefix / Exit in a FINALIZER (a mid-draw throw can never latch it) around VPE `Dialog_Psyset.DoWindowContents` and — reflection-wired — Modern UI's `DrawPsysetEditor` (scoping the EDITOR method, not the tab, so click-to-invest still works in the tree panel beside it). While active, Patch_DrawAbility keeps the level numeral but draws no "+" hint, registers no button and suppresses its own tooltip so the host's "click to add / remove" hints show.
- **BUG FIX: psycasters who join with no tree got no card** (Patch_JoinAwaken.cs). A pawn arriving with a psylink but zero unlockedPaths was a dead end (Unlock buttons disabled by our scheme; the meditation ramp only awakens NON-psycasters). `JoinAwaken.TryOffer` marks them awakened and opens the pick at `max(1, TierOf)` (the card's embrace applies the tier) + a new letter (PS_LetterJoinPsycaster*). Two entry points: postfix on `Pawn.SetFaction` (recruitment, quest joiners, wanderers, freed slaves, dev make-colonist) and a safety net inside `AwakeningTrigger.HourlyScan`'s colonist loop (existing saves, lodgers who convert without a second SetFaction, dev spawns). Guards: ProgramState.Playing, player-faction humanlike, not prisoner/slave/quest-lodger, `empirePsylinkIntegrate` + TieringControl.ExternalPsylinkAwakeningDisabled (same gate as Empire psylink grants), `pendingPick == 0`, and `cardPaths` empty (blocks a free reroll after a deliberate path surrender).
- **Always-on psycast tab** (`alwaysShowPsycastTab`, default ON, Skills tab; Patch_DormantTab.cs). VPE gates its tab on the psycast IMPLANT hediff and its FillTab early-returns without one, so forcing visibility alone yields a blank panel. Three patches: postfix on `ITab_Pawn_Psycasts.IsVisible` (force true for player humanlikes aged 13+ — only ever ADDS visibility), a `FillTab` PREFIX at Priority.First that draws a compact dormant card and returns FALSE (skips both VPE's layout and Modern UI's prefix — a false-returning prefix skips the remaining prefixes; postfixes still run and our tool-block postfix already no-ops without a psycast hediff), and an `UpdateSize` postfix at Priority.Last (wins over Modern UI's sizing) shrinking the tab to 460x268 while dormant. Card = name + "Psychically dormant" + route text (meditation vs. "another route" when enlightenment/meditation awakening is off) + an Awakening bar (cumulative awakenMeditationTicks vs `awakenGuaranteeHours`; "Chance only" when the guarantee is 0 — the insight threshold itself stays hidden by design) + a dev "awaken now" button. Caption font uses the Text.TinyFontSupported coercion rule. Draw throw = Log.Warning + return true (falls back to VPE's tab).

## PERFORMANCE LAYER (2026-07-24 quadruple pass) — PerfCache.cs + layered def caches
Architecture (do not regress when editing):
- **PerfCache** (Source/PerfCache.cs): tick/frame-scoped memo stores for StatMultiplier (per pawn+def+stat), CostMultiplier (slot 200), MaxLevel (packs psy into the value; a hit requires matching psy), ChargeStore.Max, EnlightenmentTier.TierOf. Stamp = (Time.frameCount, TicksGame, Version); ANY component change clears all stores, so cross-tick staleness is impossible. Key = pawnId<<32 | shortHash<<8 | slot (collision-free, alloc-free). `PerfCache.Bump()` MUST be called at every same-frame mutation site — currently: GameComponent SetLevel/ClearPawn/ResetPawn, EnlightenmentTier.SetTier, PsycastInfo.ClearCaches (covers PlayerTuning.Dirty, import, bake, graph rebuild), Mod.WriteSettings, Window_Specializations commit + both resets, FinalizeInit. Gated by `perfCaching` setting (Skills tab, "High performance caching", default ON) — off = every Try* misses (diagnostic escape hatch). LangCache = language-guarded Translate cache (re-resolves on language ref change).
- **PsycastInfo layered def-stable caches** (never cleared; pure functions of the def): L0 ArchFlags (beam/volley/summon bitmask — was ~40 substring scans per call), L1 RoleOf, L2 IsSingleStrike, L3 HasStat full bitmask, plus PsyExtOf/PathOf (cached GetModExtension). LAYERING RULE: each compute only calls lower layers or HasStatUncached — RoleOf's three probes MUST stay on HasStatUncached (cycle otherwise). Masks are built at startup (WarmCaches) from AUTHORED def values, deliberately immune to CastScaling's temporary def-field mutation.
- **PsycastInfo effective caches** (cleared by ClearCaches): effPrim/effPrimStr/effEdge/effEdgeStr (collapse the PlayerTuning > ManualBalance > frozen > computed layering into one dict hit — also kills the per-call "src|tgt" concat allocs) + grantsMultiCache. sourceCache unchanged.
- **Instance cache**: GameComponent_PsycastSynergies.Instance is cached per Game reference (was a linear Game.GetComponent scan × ~60 call sites); ctor seeds it; null is never latched; refs CLEARED when Current.Game is null (else the static roots the dead Game graph in the main menu).
- **SpecEffects overloads**: StatBonus/OwnAdjust/SynergyFactor/CostFactor each have a SpecData overload; ComputeStatMultiplier resolves GetSpec ONCE and passes it down (was 4 resolves per call). Pawn overloads remain as thin delegates. ElementOf cached per def.
- **UI**: SkillTooltip model precomputes ALL draw strings (recvNorm/recvAlt arrays, header/footer/req/cost lines, roleChipW, wrap heights) — Draw never Translates/concats; model cache key now includes PerfCache.Version (fixes a pre-existing stale-card bug after spec commits). Patch_PsycastTabRespec snapshots learned-count+tier per (pawn, frame) and caches all button labels (value+language keyed). Patch_DrawAbility uses SkillFx.Draw(rect, pawn, def) overload — key string only built while a burst is live. Charges gizmo computes Max once (was twice) and gates its tooltip on hover. AutoStats row tooltip build is deferred into the TipRegion lambda. Patch_HideStatUpgradeButton caches the VPE.PsycasterStats translation. MeditationBars: live fractions per pass, strings cached on a 60-tick quantum + language, LangCache captions, tooltip built only on hover.
- **Tick**: MeditationSystem.Tick(t, gc) takes the component (no per-tick resolve). HediffComp_AscensionFx reads the aura toggle every 15 ticks (cached bool). SyncPsycastHediffs reuses a static HashSet. ChargeStore sweeps dead/destroyed pawns every 120 ticks and clears fully in FinalizeInit; CastScaling amp windows likewise (SweepExpired + ClearAmplifyWindows) — three leak classes closed.
- Staleness contract: worst case ONE frame/tick for unbumped mutation paths (e.g. gear-driven ExternalBonus changes); all known same-frame paths bump. When adding ANY new mutation of skill levels, spec ownership, tier, or balance layers: call PerfCache.Bump().

## Meditation bars + pilgrimage pity (2026-07-24)
- **MeditationBars.cs** — compact EBD-style rows (caption + value over a 7px track/fill bar, Palette colors) under the focus-type icons, above Customize Psysets, in BOTH UIs. Rows (adaptive): 1) Coma risk (todayTicks vs comaSafeHours window; green→gold→red; tooltip mirrors RollHourly's exact risk formula incl. streak + reroll terms; hidden when enlightenmentEnabled off), 2) Next level (VPE XP; "Max" at cap; Accent), 3) tier 1-2: Pilgrimage pity climb (Gold; "Underway" full while a quest for that tier is offered/ongoing; "Storyteller only" empty when guarantee disabled; hidden when PilgrimagesDisabled) OR tier 3+: Transcendence climb (Violet; hidden when transcendEnabled off or TranscendenceDisabled). Tier-0 psycasters get rows 1-2 only. **FONT COERCION (bugfixed 2026-07-24): caption font = `Text.TinyFontSupported ? Tiny : Small` and CaptionH/RowH derive from `Text.LineHeightOf(thatFont)` — Text.Font's setter silently substitutes Small when tiny text is disabled (accessibility pref / Steam Deck / language), which clipped fixed-height rows. HeightFor and Draw share the same property so layout and render can never desync. See ui lore.** `broken` fuse: one draw exception hides the block + warning. Setting `medBars` (default ON, Skills tab).
- **Injection** (Patch_MeditationBars.cs): VPE-native = TRANSPILER on ITab_Pawn_Psycasts.FillTab — inserts `FillTabHook(listing, pawn)` right before the smallMode branch that draws "VPE.PsysetCustomize" (anchors: first ldstr "VPE.PsysetCustomize" → back-scan to `ldarg.0; ldfld smallMode`; Listing local via newobj→stloc; MoveLabelsFrom; miss = warning + original IL). Modern UI = reflection-only wiring (TryWireModernUI from HarmonyInit): postfix `DrawFoci(Rect c, float y)` (draw at returned cursor, advance) **AND matching postfix on LeftPanelHeight** (content-fit card; both must add EXACTLY h+8). Drawer pawn via StaticFieldRefAccess(FieldInfo overload).
- **Pilgrimage pity system** — `MeditationData.pilgrimTicks` (scribed): accrues while tier 1-2 (Accumulate chain: non-psycaster→awaken / tier≥3→transcend / tier 1-2→pilgrim). RollHourly fires `TryFirePilgrimPity` at `pilgrimGuaranteeHours`×2500 (default 60h; ×1.5 for tier 2→3; 0 = disabled): chain by PilgrimRouting style (Either = random), CanRun-guarded (falls back to the other allowed chain once, else retries next hour), GenerateQuestAndMakeAvailable + SendLetterQuestAvailable (Patch_AutoAcceptPilgrimage accepts + letters). Gates: TieringControl.PilgrimagesDisabled, PilgrimQuestOngoing(targetTier). Progress KEPT on quest fail; reset on ANY tier change (SetTier zeroes pilgrimTicks). Helpers internal for the bars: PilgrimPityThresholdTicks, PilgrimQuestOngoing, QuestTargetTier, TranscendThreshold (now internal).
- Settings: `pilgrimGuaranteeHours` FS (0-240, breakthrough section), `medBars` CB (Skills tab). Keys: PS_Bar* in PS_UI.xml, PS_SetPilgrimPity/Tip + PS_SetMedBars/Tip in PS_Settings.xml.
- KNOWN PRE-EXISTING GAP: Patch_AutoAcceptPilgrimage's letter text is hardcoded English (predates this work).

## UI polish (2026-07-24)
- **Psychic Resonance hediff hidden** — `Hediff_PsychicResonance.Visible => false` (C# override, NOT XML becomeVisible: the scribed `Hediff.visible` field latches true on existing saves and would keep the row). The hediff is still added/synced internally by EnsureHediff (data marker). Health tab no longer shows the row.
- **Locked paths say just "Locked"** — Patch_LockedNoColon.cs, transpiler on VPE `ITab_Pawn_Psycasts.DoPaths` (VPE-native tab only; Modern UI already draws plain "Locked"). Arms on `ldstr ": "` then retargets the next `string.Concat(string,string,string)` to `LockedLabel` (operand-only swap). lockPathsToEnlightenment ON → always plain "Locked"; OFF → non-empty reasons preserved, dangling colon dropped. Pattern miss → Log.Warning + IL untouched.
- **Hide unlearned paths** (`hideUnlearnedPaths`, default ON; Path access section) — filters BOTH UIs (extended 2026-07-24 after user feedback; tooltip updated):
  · VPE-native (Patch_HideUnlearnedPaths prefix/finalizer on DoPaths): swaps the private `pathsByTab[curTab]` list for a cached unlocked-only list, restored in a FINALIZER (postfix would be skipped on a mid-draw throw and the full list — built only in the tab ctor — would be lost until restart). Cache keyed (hediff, tab, source-list ref, unlockedPaths.Count). All-hidden → dim `PS_NoUnlockedPaths` hint.
  · Modern UI (TryWireModernUI, reflection-only): its tree list is built from DefDatabase inside DrawTreesPanel (no swappable field), but it has its own `S.treeFilter` — prefix forces treeFilter=2 (invested-only) for the duration of DrawTreesPanel, finalizer restores the user's saved value. The funnel button still cycles its stored setting; while forced, the view stays invested-only. Header count stays "n / total".
  · Shared gates: active ONLY while `lockPathsToEnlightenment` is on (else Unlock buttons are functional and hiding bricks point-unlocking), NEVER in the respective tab's dev mode.

## Fog of war, synergy on/off, hardcore reset-lockout, resizable constellation, pilgrimage caravan-reform, modpack balance import (2026-07-13)
- **Fog of war** (`fogOfWar`, default OFF; Skills tab). Hides un-learned psycast identities behind a dark "?" cover until unlocked. Repaint-only block in `Patch_DrawAbility.Postfix`. Tooltip suppressed via `SkillTooltip.NotifyFogHover(rect)`. Tree lines stay visible.
- **Disable synergies/empowers** (`disableSynergies`, default OFF; Skills tab). StatMultiplier skips the synergy source loop; tooltip skips received/empowers; hover-pulse guarded. TabSpec shows amber `PS_SetSynDisabledNote`.
- **Hardcore reset-lockout** (`disableSkillReset`, `disableSpecReset`, default OFF). Hide the psycast-tab "Reset skills" button and the constellation "Reset specializations" refund button. Dev resets unaffected.
- **Resizable constellation window** — Window_Specializations `resizeable = true` in ctor. Layout inRect-relative.
- **Pilgrimage completion reforms a caravan (BUG2)** — FireSuccess keeps the pilgrim's site, refreshes TimeoutComp to 15 days, sends `PS_MsgPilgrimReform`. Journey `DestroyAllSitesExcept(keep)`; FireFail spares a site the pilgrim is on.
- **Modpack-creator balance edits** — (A) `BalanceOverrideDef`: folded into overlay at END of Load(), ABOVE baked JSON, UNDER PlayerTuning. (B) In-game "Import balance edits (from JSON)" → `<SaveData>/Psycasts2/*.json` → PlayerTuning. Wiki xml-triggers.html section 9.

## Bug fixes (2026-07-13, all root-caused)
- **Settings page blanked on toggling "Disable synergies"** — checkbox flips on the MouseUp pass; conditional rows gated on the LIVE bool corrupt control state across a frame's passes. FIX: every settings tab SNAPSHOTS toggle-gated rows into locals at frame start. See ui lore. (hideUnlearnedPaths and medBars rows are unconditional; PS_SetPilgrimPity lives inside the existing showBreak block.)
- **Hemosage abilities "Disabled:" empty reason** — FIX (HarmonyInit): when lockPaths on, set ignoreLockRestrictionsForNeurotrainers=true on every path. See compat lore.
- **"Failed to find sane damage amount"** — only read projectile damage when `projProps.damageDef != null`.
- **Patch_AuraToggleGizmo warning** — added `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]`.
- **Footer covered Modern UI's psyset buttons** — `ModernUIBridge.PsysetPanelOpen` reflects private static psysetMode; footer postfix early-returns when open.
- **Footer/spec button wrong on VPE-native tab** — `ModernUIBridge.LeftCardX` (14 wired / 20 native) + `LeftCardWidth` uncapped (340 wired / size.x*0.3 native). Footer fill opaque.

## Celebration FX (SkillFx.cs)
Card-reveal-style bursts (reuses UI/Sparkle + UI/Glow + UI/Specs/node_ring). Grades: Invest, Mastery (at ABSOLUTE cap, gold border), SpecNode, SpecCapstone. ROUND grades draw NO boxes. **NO BOXES IN THE CONSTELLATION EVER**. Mastered trees: ONE postfix on PsycastsUIUtility.DoPathAbilities. Setting: skillFx (default ON). Per-icon draw goes through the gated Draw(rect, pawn, def) overload.

## Localization (full keyed layer)
Languages/English/Keyed/ (4 files, ~515 keys), ALL user-facing C# via .Translate(): PS_Lore.xml, PS_UI.xml (incl. PS_NoUnlockedPaths + PS_Bar* set), PS_Settings.xml (incl. PS_SetHidePaths/Tip, PS_SetPilgrimPity/Tip, PS_SetMedBars/Tip), PS_Specs.xml (GENERATED from Specs.cs). Missing key SHOWS as diacritic gibberish. **Edit user-facing strings in the XML, not in code.** KNOWN PRE-EXISTING GAPS: tooltip "(+N gear)" suffix and Patch_AutoAcceptPilgrimage's letter are hardcoded English. Locked-path button reuses VPE's `VPE.Locked` key.

## Balance feedback: Share JSON export + Import
Specializations tab -> "Balance edits (open beta)": PUBLIC = Share + Import + Discard. DEV-MODE = Bake into `<modRoot>/ManualBalance.json`. GOTCHA: use GenFilePaths.SaveDataFolderPath (FolderUnderSaveData is PRIVATE in 1.6). All import/bake/discard paths end in PsycastInfo.ClearCaches.

## No trait system
Enlightenment tier is the PS_Enlightenment hediff (Severity = tier). NO trait; Traits.xml empty. PS_PsychicResonance exists as an invisible internal marker.

## Psycaster level cap is FLAT (default 400), tier-independent
vpeLevelCap default 400, overrideVpeLevelCap default true -> ApplyVpeLevelCap writes VPE maxLevel. Migration balanceVersion 4->5.

## Psylink gate + random Awakened spawn (Patch_EnemyTiers, GenerateNewPawnInternal, Priority.Last)
Postfix: TryInjectTier then GatePsylink (default ON): eligible humanlikes (13+) roll awakenedSpawnChance (0.05); else psylinks stripped. noAwakenedStartingPawns (default ON) exempts PlayerStarter. All gates respect TieringControl.

## Path access & unlock control
`disableGeneRequirements` (default ON): strips requiredGene + nulls lockedReason + clears ensureLockRequirement. `lockPathsToEnlightenment` (default ON): CanPawnUnlock=false for PLAYER pawns — unlocks via cards; also forces ignoreLockRestrictionsForNeurotrainers=true (Hemosage fix). `enableLockedMechTrees` re-enables Mech-Mind paths. `hideUnlearnedPaths` (default ON) filters locked paths out of BOTH UIs; the locked-path button (when hiding off) is de-coloned by Patch_LockedNoColon.

## XML Awakening Trigger API
`AwakeningTriggerExtension` DefModExtension + funnel `AwakeningTrigger.Fire(pawn, ext, source)`. 7 surfaces. MeditationSystem.Tick calls HourlyScan every 2500 ticks. Docs: docs/wiki/xml-triggers.html.

## TieringOverrideDef — mod-facing ladder handoff
`<PsycastSynergies.TieringOverrideDef>`: disable flags + reskin. TieringControl aggregator. Trigger API ignores disables. Wiki section 8. Pity + bars respect PilgrimagesDisabled/TranscendenceDisabled.

## ISEKAI RPG compat
suppressIsekaiPsycastStats (default ON): Patch_IsekaiSuppress strips IsekaiLeveling.* StatParts at startup.

## Awakening cards
`cardRevealAll` (default off). `cardPickCount` (0=auto 3/5, 1-8 fixed). Window_Awakening `closeOnCancel=false`; only "Choose later" sets aside → `med.pendingPick` (scribed) + `Alert_PendingCardPick`.

## In-game balance editor
psycast tab, dev mode ON -> "Balance editor (dev)". Layering: PlayerTuning > ManualBalance.json + BalanceOverrideDef > frozenSyn > computed. Every editor mutation invalidates via Dirty → ClearCaches → PerfCache.Bump.

## Psycast tab tool block + focus/path pickers (Patch_PsycastTabRespec + Patch_SpecButtonInTab + ModernUIBridge)
Per-pawn gizmos REMOVED; tools live in the psycast tab's bottom tool block (postfix on ITab_Pawn_Psycasts.FillTab — runs for BOTH UIs). **Anchoring (CRITICAL):** `ModernUIBridge.LeftCardX` (14 wired / 20 VPE-native) + `LeftCardWidth(size.x)` (340 wired / size.x*0.3 native, NOT capped). Focus picking via `ModernPsycastsUI.PawnFocusHooks` (reflection); fallback "Default focus ▾" row when unwired. Footer early-returns when `ModernUIBridge.PsysetPanelOpen`. Modern Psycasts UI is a WORKSPACE mod (e33ef407d712) — source for cross-referencing; keep edits in Psycasts². MeditationBars injects via FillTab TRANSPILER (VPE) + DrawFoci/LeftPanelHeight postfixes (Modern UI); hide-unlearned forces its treeFilter around DrawTreesPanel.

## Text conventions
"Respec" BANNED (it's "Reset"); "&" BANNED (use "and"); em/en dashes BANNED; sentence case with proper nouns kept (tier names, Enlightenment, Awakening, Tier I/II/III, path/spec names, Trial of the Altar, Way of the Anima, Ancient Psycaster Order, Apotheosis, Dignified, quoted VPE button "Upgrade Psycaster Stats" — string-matched, do NOT change, Mech-Mind). ALL user-facing text lives in Languages/English/Keyed/.
